{{Quote|Wow&hellip;I wanna check his midi-chlorian count.|The barfly, noticing Rako Hardeen|<ref name="Deception" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a '''barfly''' visited [[Trueping's/Legends|Trueping's]], a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]] noticed the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]] as he entered the bar, and they subsequently attempted to attract his attention until they were interrupted by a [[Unidentified LEP servant droid (Trueping's)/Legends|LEP servant droid]] claiming to represent his employer.

==Biography==
{{Quote|This cantina is a bust&hellip;You wanna go to the next one?|The barfly, to Rako Hardeen|<ref name="Deception" />}}
[[File:UnidentifiedPatronRakoHardeen-Deception.png|thumb|left|290px|The barfly conversed with Rako Hardeen at the bar of Trueping's cantina.]]
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{FactFile2014|57|EVA 1-2|Moralo Eval}} dates the events of {{TCW|Deception}}, including the barfly's appearance, to [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Deception" /> [[Gender/Legends|woman]]<ref name="Deception AD" /> barfly was present in [[Trueping's/Legends|Trueping's]]<ref name="Trueping's name">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep415|text="Deception" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}} {{C|Slide 5}}</ref> [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on<ref name="Deception" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. They noticed as the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]] entered the establishment and asked the [[Unidentified Anacondan/Legends|Anacondan bartender]] for a shot of their finest [[Alcohol/Legends|drink]]. Slipping out of their chair and joining Hardeen at his side, the barfly inquired as to the occasion. The bounty hunter answered that he was celebrating having [[Death/Legends|killed]] the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], much to the delight of the bar's patrons.<ref name="Deception" />

Eventually, they tried to convince Hardeen to go to another cantina with them. However, the barfly was interrupted by an [[Unidentified LEP servant droid (Trueping's)/Legends|LEP servant droid]], which claimed Hardeen's employer had his [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|payment]], and the bounty hunter followed it into the back room&mdash;but not before ordering a round of beverages for all present. The barfly was later present as [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], entered the establishment looking for Hardeen. The Jedi pair apprehended an individual all present assumed was the bounty hunter, but was actually Kenobi in disguise on an undercover mission to infiltrate the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]] and investigate a kidnapping plot against [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="Deception" />

==Personality and traits==
The barfly had long [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], pale skin, and blue lips. They took an interest in Hardeen as he entered the cantina and attempted to converse with him after engaging with the bounty hunter at the bar.<ref name="Deception" />

==Equipment==
While at the cantina, the human wore a fitted black-and-tan [[Clothing/Legends|dress]] paired with tall [[Boot/Legends|boots]].<ref name="Deception" />

==Behind the scenes==
The barfly appeared in the fifteenth episode of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]], titled "[[Deception]],"<ref name="Explore: Deception">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep415|text="Deception" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> which aired on [[January 20]], [[2012]].<ref name="CW Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref> They were voiced by [[Ashley Eckstein]], the actor who also portrayed Ahsoka Tano.<ref name="Deception" />
